AssetId.description: The AssetId is a unique identifier assigned by the system operator for the PEA, which can be used for maintenance purposes. When a PEA is delivered, the AssetId has the value of the  ProductInstanceUri.

ComponentName.description: The ComponentName is the descriptive name of a PEA, which is set by the POL. So that the operator can assign the PEA to a system part, the value must be unique within a system.

DeviceClass.description: This value enables a clas-sification of PEAs. The value initially assigned by the manufacturer of a PEA can be overwritten by the system operator. This gives the plant operator the opportunity to classify the PEAs according to his principles. This guideline sheet does not define any device classes.

DeviceHealth.description: Contains the aggregated Worst Quality Code at PEA level. The default value is 16#FF. The concrete enumeration and the aggregation rules are specified in VDI/VDE/NAMUR 2658-10.

DeviceManual.description: Reference to the PEA manual (e.g. URL)

Model.description: Name of the PEA type. This name is identical to the name of the MTP

ProductCode.description: Character string for unique identification of the PEA type

ProductInstanceUri.description: Unique identifier (URI) of the PEA according to DIN SPEC 91406
